title: config/road_types.json
description: Reference: the free-flow speed and capacity of each OpenStreetMap road class, as the engine models them. Informational in this release: the engine holds these values in code (Core/common/src/osm.cpp and each engine's compiler, where they are part of every world's hashes), and this file documents them; changing it changes nothing.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

_about.description: What this file is. Not read by any program.

_help.description: Each editable value: what it means, what it accepts, its default. Not read by any program.

speed_mps.description: Free-flow speed, in metres a second (16.67 is 60 km/h). Accepts: a number above 0.

capacity_vph.description: Capacity, in vehicles an hour. Accepts: a number above 0.
